title: Delhi Police personnel protest against officer transfers

tea.why: Delhi Police personnel are protesting against the administrative transfer of two officers following a confrontation involving lawyers.
tea.want: Protesting personnel are demanding the reinstatement of the transferred Assistant Commissioner of Police and Station House Officer.
tea.changed: Nov 2: About 100 police personnel gathered outside the headquarters to protest against the officer transfers.

summary: A group of Delhi Police personnel gathered outside the police headquarters in New Delhi to protest the administrative transfers of Assistant Commissioner of Police Manasvi Vashistha and Shahdara Station House Officer Arun Kumar. The transfers followed an October 23 scuffle at the Shahdara police station involving an advocate, which had triggered an indefinite strike by district court lawyers demanding action. The protesting police officers, holding placards and posters, demanded that the two transferred officers be reinstated to their original postings and sought a meeting with the Police Commissioner. Senior officers attempted to persuade the demonstrators to voice their concerns indoors.
demands: Reinstate the transferred Assistant Commissioner of Police
Reinstate the transferred Shahdara Station House Officer
response: Senior officers, including New Delhi DCP Sachin Sharma, attempted to persuade the protesters to take up their grievances inside the headquarters rather than stage a roadside demonstration, according to The Hindu.

crowd.text: Around 100 police personnel, including women officers, were seen protesting holding placards and posters.

updates.text: A section of Delhi Police personnel planned a protest outside the force's headquarters against the transfer of two officers.
Around 100 police personnel gathered outside the police headquarters on Monday morning to protest the transfers.
